-- What a client importing `Proof.github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.Restart` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def etcdstart.restartReqNames (ρ : ReqNames) (cursor applied committed notifier logs pend cok hi
    slot ipend : GName) (inc : Nat) : ReqNames :=
  have ids :=
    { issued := ρ.ids.issued, cnt := ρ.ids.cnt, slot := slot, pfx := ρ.ids.pfx, wn := ρ.ids.wn, inc := inc,
      fs := ρ.ids.fs, pend := ipend };
  have kv :=
    { st := ρ.rd.kv.st, c0 := ρ.rd.kv.c0, ch0 := ρ.rd.kv.ch0, log0 := ρ.rd.kv.log0, cok := cok, hi := hi, ids := ids,
      hist := ρ.rd.kv.hist, cmp := ρ.rd.kv.cmp, rlog := ρ.rd.kv.rlog, cret := ρ.rd.kv.cret, lm := ρ.rd.kv.lm,
      gps := ρ.rd.kv.gps };
  { wait := ρ.wait,
    rd :=
      { cursor := cursor, applied := applied, committed := committed, notifier := notifier, logs := logs, pend := pend,
        raft := ρ.rd.raft, kv := kv } }

theorem etcdstart.idKeyFact_pfxOk [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] {X : Type} [Pos.Countable X] (issued
    cnt wn fs : GName) (Φs : X → w64 → List w8 → GName → IProp GF) (k : IdKey) (x : X) (E : CoPset)
    (HE : ↑idClusterN ⊆ E) : ⊢ idClusterInv issued cnt wn fs Φs -∗ idKeyFactAt fs k x ={E}=∗
    ⌜idPfxOk k.fst⌝

theorem etcdstart.bootPremiseR_persistent (N : Nat) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs :
    List (List w8)) (dir : w64 → List GoString) (token name : GoString) (Uok : BootURLs → Prop) (id
    : w64) : Persistent (etcdstart.bootPremiseR N ps bootLog ctxs dir token name Uok id)

def etcdstart.memberBuiltR (s : Loc) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (lg : Loc) (γn : NetNames
    GF) (id : w64) (N : Nat) (served : Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γA ci TM E γrn b cfg γk τ at₀ A,
      ⌜envAgree E E₀ ∧
            E.authOn = false ∧ cfg.Logger' = lg ∧ cfg.TracerOptions' = slice.nil ∧ cfg.WatchProgressNotifyInterval' = 0⌝ ∗
        srvServeStock s E ∗
          srvWatchBuilt s E ∗
            srvBuiltR s γA ci TM E ρ ρ.rd
                (srvEr ρ E₀ (W64 0) (W64 0) (restartKV ρ.rd.kv A) id (srvTrKey γn γk) (srvTrStopK γk)) γrn b (W64 0) at₀
                (W64 0) (restartKV ρ.rd.kv A) N ∗
              srvServeBuilt s E cfg ∗
                srvSVRes s E ∗
                  srvMonitorsOff s ∗
                    srvMonitorRes s ∗
                      srvReadyCloser s ∗
                        srvNetMember γn s id τ ∗
                          srvTrTok γn τ ∗
                            etcdstart.memberPeerServeRes γn τ served ∗
                              etcdstart.srvLeaseRd s E lease.Mode.none ∗ srvStop.keep s cfg E γrn γk)

def etcdstart.memberRestartFacts (γ : SrvRaft) (ρ : ReqNames) (id : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜ρ.rd.raft = { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } ∧
          ρ.rd.kv.c0 = W64 0 ∧
            ρ.rd.kv.ch0 = apply.alarmChain false false false ∧
              ρ.rd.kv.log0 = [[], []] ∧
                ρ.ids.pfx = idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)) ∧ ρ.rd.kv.cmp = false ∧ lease.runCfg ρ.rd.kv.lm lease.Mode.none⌝ ∗
      ⌜¬clusterNoSnap γ.cl⌝ ∗
        srvRaftLogInv ρ.rd.raft ∗
          idClusterInv ρ.ids.issued ρ.ids.cnt ρ.ids.wn ρ.ids.fs srvFloorFacts ∗
            idNoZero ρ.ids ∗
              srvPropMint ρ.rd.raft ρ.ids ∗
                srvRdCtxInv ρ.rd.raft ρ.ids.issued ∗ kvInv ρ.rd.raft ρ.rd.kv ∗ ∃ x, idKeyFactAt ρ.ids.fs ρ.ids.key x)

theorem etcdstart.memberBoot_restartFacts [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (γ : SrvRaft) (ctxs : List (List
    w8)) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (Φs : w64 → w64 → List w8 → GName → IProp GF) (id :
    w64) : etcdstart.memberBoot γ ctxs ρ E₀ Φs id ⊢ etcdstart.memberRestartFacts γ ρ id ∗
    etcdstart.memberBoot γ ctxs ρ E₀ Φs id

def etcdstart.bootPremiseR (N : Nat) (ps : List w64) (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs : List (List w8))
    (dir : w64 → List GoString) (token name : GoString) (Uok : BootURLs → Prop) (id : w64) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ cfg U γ,
        ⌜etcdstart.cfgOk token name cfg ∧ Uok U ∧ γ.vs = ps ∧ γ.rule = srvRule (W64 0) bootLog ∧ γ.boot = bootLog⌝ -∗
          bootstrapRestartContract cfg U γ id N dir)

def etcdstart.memberRestartBoot (γ : SrvRaft) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ : apply.AEnv GF) (Φs : w64 → w64 →
    List w8 → GName → IProp GF) (id : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜ρ.rd.raft = { raft := γ, pre := [], ai0 := W64 0 } ∧
          ρ.rd.kv.c0 = W64 0 ∧
            ρ.rd.kv.ch0 = apply.alarmChain false false false ∧
              ρ.rd.kv.log0 = [[], []] ∧
                ρ.ids.pfx = idPfxOf (W16 (uint.Z id)) ∧
                  Φs ρ.ids.pfx = srvFloorFact E₀ ∧
                    E₀.cmp = false ∧
                      ρ.rd.kv.cmp = false ∧ E₀.Nx = srvApi.kvNx ρ.rd false ∧ lease.runCfg ρ.rd.kv.lm lease.Mode.none⌝ ∗
      ⌜¬clusterNoSnap γ.cl⌝ ∗
        srvRaftLogInv ρ.rd.raft ∗
          idClusterInv ρ.ids.issued ρ.ids.cnt ρ.ids.wn ρ.ids.fs srvFloorFacts ∗
            idKeyFactAt ρ.ids.fs ρ.ids.key E₀.γs.slog ∗
              idNoZero ρ.ids ∗
                srvPropMint ρ.rd.raft ρ.ids ∗
                  srvRdCtxInv ρ.rd.raft ρ.ids.issued ∗
                    idShare ρ.ids ∗
                      idWaitTok ρ.ids ∗
                        srvApi.newServerStoreFreshA E₀.γs ∗
                          ghostMapAuth ρ.rd.kv.cok 1 ∅ ∗
                            ghostMapAuth E₀.γrev 1 ∅ ∗ srvReadNamesFreshNK ρ.rd ∗ kvInv ρ.rd.raft ρ.rd.kv)

theorem etcdstart.memberRestartFacts_persistent (γ : SrvRaft) (ρ : ReqNames) (id : w64) : Persistent
    (etcdstart.memberRestartFacts γ ρ id)

theorem etcdstart.memberRestartFacts_alloc [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (hne : mvcc.api.names_nonempty.law)
    (γ : SrvRaft) (ρ : ReqNames) (id : w64) : ⊢ etcdstart.memberRestartFacts γ ρ id ={⊤}=∗ ∃ ρ' E₀
    Φs, ⌜restartNames ρ ρ'⌝ ∗ etcdstart.memberRestartBoot γ ρ' E₀ Φs id

theorem etcdstart.restartReqNames_restartNames (ρ : ReqNames) (cursor applied committed notifier
    logs pend cok hi slot ipend : GName) (inc : Nat) : restartNames ρ (etcdstart.restartReqNames ρ
    cursor applied committed notifier logs pend cok hi slot ipend inc)
